description: This PHP class, EmployeeDistributionBySubunitModel, represents a data model used in the OrangeHRM Dashboard API to serialize information about employee distribution across different subunits. It implements normalization functionality and uses traits for model behaviors, encapsulating subunit details and employee counts.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunitModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee distribution data by subunit in the dashboard API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a SubunitCountPair object and configures serialization filters and attribute mappings.
